sampled_retention.interpretation: These are repeated known-scene checks, not independent generalization trials.

paired_dense_rankings.interpretation: Improvements and regressions refer to demonstration-action rankings on matched reference inputs, not inferred physical successes or failures.

first_update_supervision_comparison.scope: This isolates the new row coefficient at the first update; later trajectories evolve separately.

limitations: Local weight 2 changes only the selected supervised hinge coefficient; the denominator stays 117 and TD weighting is unchanged.
Dense reference-state rankings are not additional physical episode evaluations and may concern states the policy no longer visits.
A more positive step-21 gap can coexist with new neighboring-action errors; these are reported separately.
The data contain three known scenes and one initialization. No held-out or online-learning claim is supported.
The analyzer performs no environment reset, environment step, optimizer update or forced-action rescue.
